query: UPDATE sessions s SET identity_kind=x.kind,identity_key=x.identity_key,had_error=x.had_error,depth=x.depth,first_tool=x.first_tool,last_tool=x.last_tool FROM (SELECT session_id,(array_agg((analytics_identity(caller))[1] ORDER BY ts,id) FILTER(WHERE analytics_identity(caller) IS NOT NULL))[1] AS kind,(array_agg((analytics_identity(caller))[2] ORDER BY ts,id) FILTER(WHERE analytics_identity(caller) IS NOT NULL))[1] AS identity_key,bool_or(is_error) AS had_error,count(*) FILTER(WHERE type='tool.called') AS depth,(array_agg(tool ORDER BY ts,id) FILTER(WHERE type='tool.called'))[1] AS first_tool,(array_agg(tool ORDER BY ts DESC,id DESC) FILTER(WHERE type='tool.called'))[1] AS last_tool FROM events WHERE project_id=$1 AND session_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY session_id) x WHERE s.project_id=$1 AND s.session_id=x.session_id
